730770101.text: Oh no, the stone lock is gone!

730770102.text: Who could have broken the lock? Could it be the Big Iron Chunk?

730770104.text: Eh? The Golden Nara and the silver bird can see Aradashan?

730770105.text: #Paimon is not a silver bird! And gold... Well, this is {NICKNAME}.

730770106.text: #Okay, Aradashan gets it. It's Nara {NICKNAME} and Paimon. Aradashan's name is Aradashan.

730770107.text: Hmmm... You're a Golden Nara, with the same Golden hair as Nara Varuna, with the warm scent of a sun-kissed leaf...

730770108.text: #Oh, but now is not the time to make friends. The stone lock... Did you see who broke it, Nara {NICKNAME} and Paimon!?

730770109.text: The stone lock is probably what we just opened...

730770111.text: #No, so Nara {NICKNAME} was the one breaking the lock...? Aradashan thought the Big Iron Chunks escaped on their own!

730770112.text: The stone lock is gone! The Big Iron Chunk is coming out!

730770113.text: #You should hide, Nara {NICKNAME} and Paimon! Big Iron Chunks are big and hard, some even shoot fire out of their eyes! Very dangerous!

730770114.text: Do you mean the monster trapped inside? We've dealt with it already.

730770115.text: Really? So the Big Iron Chunk was destroyed? Great news! Aradashan was about to shed leaves at the thought of them pouring out!

730770116.text: #So Nara {NICKNAME} and Paimon took down the Big Iron Chunk here?

730770117.text: We've taken loads of monsters like them down in the past!

730770121.text: #Aradashan didn't expect Nara {NICKNAME} to be so powerful. Uh, can Nara {NICKNAME} help...?

730770122.text: Could it be related to the stone locks?

730770123.text: So smart, Paimon! Aradashan is somewhat a bit surprised...

730770124.text: What is there to be surprised about!?

730770125.text: Hehe, yes, it is related to the stone locks.

730770126.text: #There are sixteen stone locks in total in the forest with Big Iron Chunks inside... Can {NICKNAME} defeat them?

730770120.text: Hehe, Paimon knows just where to hide!

730770401.text: #You're very powerful, Nara {NICKNAME}. We'll defeat the Bulky Iron Chunk for sure!

730770501.text: Will we defeat the Bulky Iron Chunk? It is a terrible monster as told in the legends... Uhhh...

730770601.text: It is said the Bulky Iron Chunk has many forms and can turn into many Big Iron Chunks.

730770602.text: #But it will be vulnerable once you beat any of its key parts, so watch carefully, Nara {NICKNAME}.

730770701.text: I don't speak to Nara often.

730770801.text: Whoa, Aradashan didn't think that the Bulky Iron Chunk would still be so strong after we used Ararakalari.

730770802.text: Even if our Ararakalari could defeat Big Iron Chunks, we wouldn't be able to handle the Bulky Iron Chunk.

730770804.text: It's okay, since the Perpetual Mechanical Array... Uh, Bulky Iron Chunk is defeated, there will be no more iron monsters in the forests!

730770805.text: Yeah, you can rest assured now.

730770808.text: #Arasaha is right. Seeing Nara {NICKNAME} fighting the Bulky Iron Chunk had us in awe.

730770809.text: There is still a long way to go before catching up with the great Aradasha.

730770810.text: We must train harder, so we can be heroes like Aradasha in the next crisis!

730770811.text: We must fight the imaginary Bulky Iron Chunk in our dream!

730770814.text: #When you want to, Nara {NICKNAME}, just sing the Rhythm of the Great Dream like when you entered Vanarana.

730770815.text: Then you can join and share our dream of the Bulky Iron Chunk.

730770816.text: Somehow that sounds more like a nightmare...

730770818.text: Paimon doesn't want to dream about fighting! Paimon only wants to dream about eating delicious food!

730770821.text: Aradashan will go train in dreams with Arasata, Arayuta, and Arasaha now!

730770822.text: #As a sign of my gratitude, Nara {NICKNAME}, I shall remember you with the first ray of dawn.

730770823.text: #Nara {NICKNAME}, is as great as Nara Varuna!

730770825.text: Yes, let's meet again in the dream later!

730770820.text: True, it's their dream, after all. The Perpetual Mechanical Array won't be real and we won't get hurt.

730770928.text: #Oh! Nara {NICKNAME} and Paimon are so amazing! Now Aradashan knows why the air and ground in the forest have become cleaner.

730770929.text: Wait for Aradashan! Aradashan is going to get the friends!

730770920.text: Hehe, Paimon knows just where to hide!

730771002.text: Whoa! So many Aranara appeared out of nowhere...

730771003.text: #Nara {NICKNAME} and Paimon, these are Arasata, Arasaha, and Arayuta.

730771004.text: More Aranara names! Aradashan, Arasata, Arasaha, and...

730771007.text: Paimon knows my name now. I'm so happy!

730771011.text: Aradashan, you told us to come see you after we're done with all the Big Iron Chunks... What for?

730771012.text: Oh, it goes way, way back...

730771013.text: Several hundred cycles of trees ago, the iron monsters appeared. Some were big iron Nara, some were legless big iron Nara.

730771014.text: The monsters were as tall as mountains, spewing light as bright as fire. They made the forests weep and bushes wail in the howling fire.

730771015.text: You mean the Big Iron Chunks?

730771017.text: Let me tell the story from that point on. I like the rest part of the story.

730771018.text: When things were at their most perilous, the great Aradasha emerged.

730771019.text: The great Aradasha defeated many, many Big Iron Chunks with Ararakalari and locked them up with stone locks.

730771020.text: Just like that, the great Aradasha restored peace to much foliage, allowing Nara and Aranara to rest in the forest at night.

730771021.text: So, all the Ruin Graders and Ruin Drakes and stuff from the stone locks we unlocked were defeated and confined by Aradasha!?

730771022.text: Yeah, Aradasha was super powerful, taking on all those Big Iron Chunks like that! Aradasha stories are my favorites!

730771023.text: #But if the Big Iron Chunks that Aradasha put away have been defeated by {NICKNAME}, why did you want us to come here?

730771024.text: Well... Aradasha locked the Big Iron Chunks away, but even the hardest earth erodes and crumbles in time...

730771025.text: Same as the stone locks. They crack and fracture until they become Valuka.

730771026.text: Then the Big Iron Chunks can shrug off the stone locks to bring doom to the woods. So, we must guard the locks.

730771027.text: But it would be bad if we should miss any loose locks, so Aradashan, Arasata, Arasaha, and Arayuta must become more powerful.

730771028.text: If we could defeat them with Ararakalari like Arabalika can, we wouldn't have to worry about the stone locks turning into Valuka.

730771029.text: So you wanted to beat the Big Iron Chunks yourselves...

730771030.text: Uh... How did that become our problem?

730771031.text: Uh, we can't defeat the Big Iron Chunks right now, so if we released them from those stone locks just like that...

730771034.text: #But Nara {NICKNAME} is powerful and can defeat the Big Iron Chunks. With Nara {NICKNAME}'s help, we can beat the mighty Bulky Iron Chunk!

730771035.text: So you called us here to deal with the Bulky Iron Chunk?

730771036.text: Bulky Iron Chunk is mightier than Big Iron Chunk. We could only contain it with our Ararakalari.

730771037.text: #So when Aradashan saw Nara {NICKNAME} defeat Big Iron Chunks, Aradashan thought Nara {NICKNAME} could defeat Bulky Chunk.

730771038.text: #So Aradashan would like to ask Nara {NICKNAME} for another favor...

subQuests.subQuestName: Go to the cavern Aradashan mentioned

730770301.text: So this is the Bulky Iron Chunk.

730770302.text: Since the Big Iron Chunks are Ruin Graders, Ruin Drakes, and the likes... It's no surprise that the Bulky Iron Chunk was actually a Perpetual Mechanical Array...

730770303.text: Strange. Why do you call the Bulky Iron Chunk "Perlulu Manacle Array"?

730770304.text: Oh, the name will fit pretty soon... But we'll stick to calling it Bulky Iron Chunk for now.

730770306.text: #The Bulky Iron Chunk can fly and crash down like a meteor. Be careful, Nara {NICKNAME}.

730770308.text: #We'll help you by using our Ararakalari, Nara {NICKNAME}!

730770309.text: Release the Bulky Iron Chunk when you're ready!
